text:
## Status Vocabulary  
| Status | Meaning | Permitted Use |
|---|---|---|
| Draft | Not approved for operational use | Context only; do not rely on it for a decision |
| Active | Approved and currently effective | Apply if it governs the question date |
| Superseded | Replaced by a named later document | Use only for historical questions before replacement |
| Withdrawn | No longer valid and not replaced | Do not use as operating guidance |

raw_entities.name: Document Reliance Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk that draft or withdrawn documents are applied operationally when they should not be, leading to non-compliance or incorrect decision-making. The vocabulary explicitly restricts reliance on draft documents to context only and prohibits use of withdrawn documents as operating guidance.
